main_body: Large round leaf canopy with a spreading root-flared trunk underneath
top_band: Light and mid green leaf clumps across the upper canopy (rows ~1-12) lead into a darker green body; there is no distinct flat top band
evidence: An organic canopy blob reads as a volume. Its lit upper clumps, the darker underside around rows 54-62 and the trunk below match the Beodeul tree structure. There is no architectural top/front split, so the front-edge and recess checks do not apply. No receding side face is drawn, and the trunk and roots are seen from the south.

style.evidence: The canopy uses only about 3 greens plus a dark brown trunk ramp, against the references' 5-6 steps with brighter highlights and darker leaf shadows. The outline is a uniform near-black line around the whole silhouette, where the references use dark green. The leaf clumps are dithered noise rather than shaped, individually lit leaf clusters. The large dark green mid-canopy and the trunk area are nearly flat, and the trunk has little bark detail. It looks flatter and more sticker-like than the references.
